name: Stormsignal
description: An accretion-powered pulsar flashing in X-rays as it strips its unseen companion's wind. One scorched planet endures the beam while a dwarf tumbles outside. The signal carries data no telescope can ignore.

stars.name: Stormsignal Beacon
stars.description: A neutron star fed by a companion wind, pulsing in X-rays every ten seconds. Cyclotron lines in its spectrum map a trillion-gauss field. Outbursts arrive in types one and two, both scheduled by physics.

planets.name: Signalrock
planets.description: An iron world catching the pulsar's beam once per ten-second turn. The dayside fluoresces faintly with each sweep. Shielded vaults store observations the beam would corrupt.

dwarfPlanets.name: Signal Minor
dwarfPlanets.description: A rocky dwarf outside the worst of the beam, keeping primordial chemistry. Its craters predate the pulsar's spin-up. Samplers time their visits to the quiet phase.
